tools.name: account
tools.description: Free. Your credit balance, the price of every tool, and where to top up.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search this site (asset profile, article). Returns ids, titles, dates, links and the price of reading each in full. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_excerpt
tools.description: A cited passage from one document, centred on your query, with the source link. Costs 3 credits.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: The full text of one document. The price depends on its type and is shown by search.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: One asset profile by name, slug or ticker. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: bulk_articles
tools.description: Up to 50 articles with full text in one call, newest first, optionally matching a query. Costs 100 credits.

tools.name: attention_movers
tools.description: Assets ranked by reader attention on this site (profile views) over the last N days, with the change against the N days before. The window is stated in the answer. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: attention_history
tools.description: Daily attention (profile views) for one asset, up to 365 days back. Costs 10 credits.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
